item: The operator curates the predictions the app suggests in a stored IPCC Summary for Policymakers
summary: 0.6 gate row A, register ruling G4: operator-curated prediction extraction from a suggested list. A sentence of a stored SPM is suggested when its wording carries an IPCC calibrated likelihood or confidence term and a future-looking word (projected, will, a year after the approval, a scenario name); the matched words are on the row, the list keeps the report's order, a passage too long to be one sentence is counted and not shown. Nothing is stored until a person keeps a sentence or sets it aside (ipcc_predictions, keyed by SPM key and sentence hash; the sentence is the server's copy, a hash that is no suggestion is refused). A decision a later method no longer suggests stays listed in full. A restore carries the decisions, local wins, a different incoming decision is counted as a conflict. Short caveat visible, method one click away, x12; both routes local, the decision a POST.
